eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Three
subtitle: Lesson 23 · Joining Tables

code:
SELECT p.Name, p.ListPrice, sod.OrderQty
FROM Production.Product AS p
LEFT JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS sod
    ON p.ProductID = sod.ProductID;
caption: Every product appears — even ones never ordered. Unmatched OrderQty comes back NULL.

code:
SELECT p.Name
FROM Production.Product AS p
LEFT JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS sod
    ON p.ProductID = sod.ProductID
WHERE sod.ProductID IS NULL;
caption: Every product that has NEVER appeared in a sales order.

subtitle: The mirror image of what you just learned.
